ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels vs 20% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white central region; solid low-intensity black perimeter band along the trailing edge; vertical low-intensity pixel columns on the far left lateral margin; sparse linear low-intensity filaments on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the central axis; estimated pixel angle of 50 degrees with a high-depth bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency variations; multiple sharp pixel peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in amplitude relative to the local baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the primary axis of each lobe, terminating in sharp, tapered distal points with a slight upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular pixel clusters (barnacles) localized on the dark-pigmented distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel tracks on the right lobe; longest feature originates near the median notch and extends diagonally towards the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel dark linear abrasions on the right lobe; significantly jagged and irregular trailing edge contour suggesting historical physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'comb-like' or 'digitized' vertical black pigmentation bars located on the outer-most region of the left lobe.
